label: Medium / Render Style
description: What kind of image this is — every prompt describes one.

items.name: photorealistic
items.text: hyper-realistic photograph, true-color optics, skin showing pores and fine vellus hair, every material keeping its real reflectance — metal cool, fabric matte, glass sharp

items.name: cinematic-still
items.text: cinematic film still, wide anamorphic framing with oval bokeh and a faint horizontal flare, subtle grain, the composed stillness of a paused frame

items.name: analog-film
items.text: analog 35mm film photograph, warm negative-stock color, gentle halation blooming around highlights, organic grain riding the shadows

items.name: anime
items.text: anime illustration, confident clean line art, flat cel shading split by crisp shadow terminators, large expressive eyes with layered specular highlights

items.name: oil-painting
items.text: classical oil painting, transparent glazes over visible brushwork, impasto highlights catching raking light

items.name: watercolor
items.text: delicate watercolor painting, wet-on-wet washes blooming into each other, granulating pigment, the white of the paper left as light

items.name: 3d-render
items.text: polished 3D render, physically-based materials with correct fresnel falloff, soft global-illumination bounce, crisp contact shadows grounding every object

items.name: comic-ink
items.text: comic book ink and flat colour, bold contour lines, benday dot shading and panel-ready staging
items.text_short: comic book ink, bold contours and benday dots

items.name: gouache
items.text: matte gouache painting, opaque velvety layers and crisp poster-like edges

items.name: charcoal
items.text: expressive charcoal drawing, smudged shadow masses, highlights lifted out with an eraser, rough paper tooth

items.name: colored-pencil
items.text: layered colored-pencil illustration, directional strokes following the form, waxy burnished blends, paper tooth flecking white through the pigment

items.name: pastel-chalk
items.text: soft pastel chalk artwork, powdery blooms of color with fingertip blending

items.name: ink-wash
items.text: east-asian ink wash painting, tonal gradients of black ink and confident empty space

items.name: paper-collage
items.text: hand-crafted paper cut-out collage, layered torn edges, mixed textures and visible depth

items.name: stained-glass
items.text: stained-glass artwork, leaded outlines and luminous translucent color panes

items.name: pixel-art
items.text: detailed pixel art, deliberate limited palette and crisp dithered shading

items.name: vector-illustration
items.text: clean vector illustration, smooth curves, flat fills and geometric precision

items.name: embroidery
items.text: embroidered textile artwork, visible stitch directions and raised thread texture

items.name: fresco
items.text: buon fresco mural painting, pigment sunk into wet lime plaster, chalky matte surface, hairline craquelure and faint sinopia underdrawing

items.name: airbrush
items.text: 80s airbrush illustration, seamless sprayed gradients, chrome highlights with starburst glints, frisket-masked razor edges

items.name: claymation
items.text: stop-motion claymation still, hand-sculpted plasticine characters with visible thumbprints, miniature set depth of field

items.name: marker-concept
items.text: industrial-design marker rendering, confident sweeping alcohol-marker strokes on warm grey paper, white gel-pen edge highlights, loose construction lines left showing

items.name: tintype
items.text: wet-plate collodion tintype, silver image on blackened metal, shallow chemical focus, swirled emulsion flaws at the edges, pale luminous skin against inky darkness

items.name: illuminated-manuscript
items.text: medieval illuminated manuscript page, mineral pigments and burnished gold leaf on vellum, ornamented initial letters, vine-scroll borders inhabited by tiny creatures
